info.title: Mono
info.synopsis: Satsuki Amamiya e la sua migliore amica An Kiriyama facevano parte del club di fotografia della scuola, con la prima che ammirava la senpai e presidentessa Sakihara. Questo fino a quando lei ed i restanti membri del terzo anno si sono diplomati, lasciando Satsuki nello sconforto ed il club nel caos. Per pura coincidenza una fotocamera comprata da Satsuki non arriva in tempo e, assieme ad An, vanno in visita al venditore per chiedere spiegazioni. Qui faranno la conoscenza con Haruno Akiyama, un'aspirante mangaka che vuole creare un manga entusiasmante con protagoniste delle studentesse delle superiori. A scuola le due incontrano Sakurako Shikishima, la presidentessa del club di cinema che sta vivendo un problema simile a quello di fotografia. Per evitarne la chiusura Sakurako ha l'idea di fonderli assieme dando vita al cinefoto club. Ora questo trio, assieme ad Haruno e alla motoblogger Kako Komada, si è prefissato un nuovo obiettivo: scattare foto nei luoghi turistici del Giappone per aiutare la mangaka a raggiungere il proprio sogno!

episodes.title: Mono Trip
episodes.synopsis: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

episodes.title: Making of Some Aerial Photography! / Visiting a Classmate, 3000 Leagues - Motovlog Part 12
episodes.synopsis: Satsuki and An use a makeshift drone to try some photography when they receive notice that the photography club will be dissolved due to the lack of members. Troubled by this news, they invite fellow classmate Sakurako Shikishima from the Cinema Club, which has also received a dissolution notice. Meanwhile, Haruno is stuck on her manga draft when her high school friend, Kako Komada, pays her a visit. The two hit the road for a tour.

episodes.title: Right Before It Becomes an Anime!! The Manga Pilgrimage Stamp Rally with a Schedule from Hell!
episodes.synopsis: Haruno gets word of a manga that will be adapted into an anime. As she lives in the real-life location of that manga's story, she scouts out locations and decides to make it a focus for her manga creations. Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

episodes.title: A Comfy Manga Artist Goes On a Winery Tour - Motovlog Part 13 / Taking Pictures of Food and Getting Full Until We Explode
episodes.synopsis: Haruno invites Satsuki and the rest to join an event where they take pictures and eat while walking. The three girls happily accept, thinking it's the perfect event for the Cinephoto Club, but they find out they'll be going around shops that serve generous portions of food to the point they'll be full! They're disappointed in the food brought to them, but this is just the beginning of their fight.

episodes.title: The Story of Dry-Cured Ham in Yamanashi / A Haunted Spot and Incident of Possession
episodes.synopsis: The dry-cured ham that Haruno was looking forward to enjoying ended up being used as one of the recipe's ingredients! With a little convincing from Kako, the group heads out to buy some famous Yatsugatake ham instead. While on the road, they drop by abandoned places and ski areas here and there, enjoying some Kiyosato curry and visiting a variety of stores that sell ham.

episodes.title: Taking the Perfect Picture of a Maruishi Dosojin in Yamanashi! / We`ll Enjoy Some Curry in Yamanashi
episodes.synopsis: As a story idea for Haruno's manga, the girls participate in a "maruishi" hunting event in the prefecture.

episodes.title: First Time for an Anime Adaptation / Calling All Manga Artists! Minobu Walker
episodes.synopsis: One of Haruno's manga artist friends, Isuzu, gets her work selected to be adapted into an anime! Worried about the money involved and how busy she'll be, she confides in Kurokuma and Haruno about how uneasy she feels about everything. The girls worry for Isuzu and, as a change of pace, participate in the Minobu Donburi Walk together.

episodes.title: Nagano / Toyama Trip That`s on the Test (The First Night)
episodes.synopsis: Haruno and the Cinephoto Club head to Nagano for a two-night-three-day trip for a scoop. While everyone raises their hand to suggest places they want to go to, An says she wants to film some skateboarding downhill with an action camera. To do this, though, they'll need someone to ride the skateboard with her....

episodes.title: Nagano / Toyama Trip That`s on the Test (The Second Night)
episodes.synopsis: The girls meet up and head over to Kurobe Dam, where they watch a documentary about the dam's construction.

episodes.title: Nagano / Toyama Trip That`s on the Test (The Third Night)
episodes.synopsis: It's the last day, and the group has gone all over Nagano to get this scoop. The group arrives at Togakushi, Nagano, where they try making fresh soba. They break into two teams: adults and children, and have a competition to make some soba! And finally, the group makes their last stop at a Ninja Trick Mansion, but what exactly awaits them there?

episodes.title: Enjoying All the Spots on the Yamanashi Shaved Ice Map
episodes.synopsis: There are only two days left of summer vacation. As Cinephoto Club reflects upon this past summer, they realize they haven't eaten shaved ice yet! To make this the best summer vacation without any regrets, the group takes one last trip to enjoy all the shaved ice spots listed on the Yamanashi Shaved Iced Map.

episodes.title: POV Horror - What Ever Shall We Do?
episodes.synopsis: The Cinephoto Club begins shooting a horror film, though not everything is as it seems.

info.title: Mobile Suit Gundam F-91 (ITA)
info.synopsis:
U.C. 0123. Mobile Suit Gundam F91 è il tentativo del creatore di Gundam, Yoshiyuki Tomino, di lanciare una nuova saga della serie, ambientata trent'anni dopo Il contrattacco di Char.

La storia di Gundam F91 ruota attorno al giovane colono spaziale Seabook Arno, alla sua amica Cecily Fairchild e agli sforzi della milizia Crossbone Vanguard, guidata dal nonno di Cecily, Meitzer Ronah, per stabilire un'aristocrazia chiamata "Cosmo Babylonia".

Fedele alla tradizione di Gundam, il civile Seabook è costretto dalle circostanze a pilotare il Gundam F91, progettato in parte dalla madre da cui è separato, la dottoressa Monica Arno.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In UC 0123 renewed conflict breaks out after a generation of peace in this continuation of the "Mobile Suit Gundam" anime saga. To accommodate the growing population, the Earth Federation has built new space colonies. But the Crossbone Vanguard decides to seize these cities to help establish its extraterrestrial empire. Now, reluctant hero Seabook Arno and his Gundam F91 must lead a fierce struggle for survival.

info.title: Soul Link
info.synopsis: Aizawa Ryota aveva raggiunto il terzo grado del corso di preparazione dell'Accademia militare centrale. Viene così trasferito in una stazione spaziale, la Ariete, per un addestramento intensivo con i suoi compagni di classe, tra cui Nagase Saka e Nittak Kazuhiko. Tuttavia, la stazione viene attaccata da un gruppo terroristico, gli Hallarax. Ora Ryota e compagni devono trovare un modo per tornare sani e salvi sulla terra.

info.title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart
info.synopsis: Una notte, Arisu, si imbatte in una misteriosa trasmissione radiofonica che ha il potere di rasserenarlo: "Midnight Heart Tune". La voce suadente della conduttrice, conosciuta solo con il nome di Apollo, lo affascina e lo avvolge in un'atmosfera misteriosa, che presto diventa una parte imprescindibile delle sue notti. Tuttavia, con il passare del tempo, la trasmissione e la sua enigmatica dj scompaiono nel nulla, lasciando ad Arisu il solo ricordo di quella voce misteriosa. Non sa che aspetto abbia né il suo vero nome, tuttavia anni dopo, nel corso del liceo, Arisu scopre un nuovo indizio che potrebbe rivelare la vera identità di Apollo ed è proprio all'interno del club di radiodiffusione della sua scuola. Qui incontra quattro ragazze, ognuna delle quali con un sogno che ruota attorno all'uso della propria voce. Chi di loro sarà Apollo? Determinato a scoprire la verità, il ragazzo si imbarca in una missione che lo porterà a fare da guida e supporto a queste ragazze, aiutandole a realizzare i loro sogni e, forse, a svelare il segreto nascosto dietro "Midnight Heart Tune".

episodes.title: I`m Just Going at Full Strength
episodes.synopsis:
Seirin High School makes it into the semifinals of the Winter Cup. They defeated Toô Gakuen, featuring Aomine, and Yosen, featuring Murasakibara, both from the "Generation of Miracles," causing Seirin to be one of the more noticed schools. They firm their resolve towards the semifinals. Kagami, nudged by Kuroko, heads outside of the tournament building in order to reconcile with Himuro, but seeing a guy picking a fight with Himuro and Alex, steps in to help.
That guy is Shogo Haizaki of Fukuda Sogo Gakuen. He is a graduate of Teiko Junior HIgh, and he was supposedly a regular player in the first-string team before Kise joined...

episodes.title: This Is Mine
episodes.synopsis:
The other semifinal between Kaijo and Fukuda Sogo begins. For Kise, Haizaki is a nemesis that he has not once won against. Being on Teiko Middle School's starting lineup, Haizaki's skills were definitely there, but due to his arrogant attitude that ignores the rest of the team, the Kaijo team members feel anger against him.

Kaijo attacks with steady play but cannot stop Haizaki. Furthermore, Haizaki shoots Moriyama's irregular three pointer as if to show off...! This was Haizaki's ultimate skill, similar to, but different from, Kise's "Copy"!

episodes.title: Don`t You Get In My Way
episodes.synopsis: Haizaki's skill is not copying a move he's seen once, but to "pillage" it. Kaijo starts to be cornered as each player's signature plays are sealed away. Even Kise, who has a variety of moves thanks to his Copy skill, starts to run out of stock moves as the game progresses. Furthermore, the fierce game pace puts Kise's leg close to its limit... The groove is completely with Fukuda Sogo at an advantage, causing frustration as the Kaijo team couldn't move as they wanted. Kise finally kneels down, but at that moment, a cheer from Kuroko reaches him from the audience. Kise stands up once again as if to answer that voice and uses his new skill Perfect Copy to start the comeback run!

episodes.title: I`ll Take This For Now
episodes.synopsis:
The final four of Winter Cup has finally been decided. However, on the day of the semifinals, Kuroko and Kagami both realized their basketball shoes were broken and hurriedly get on their way to buy new shoes. However, Kagami can't find shoes in his size! Thanks to Kuroko's suggestion, they seek advice from Momoi, and her reply is that he should use Aomine's shoes, as they both have the same shoe size. Of course, Aomine wasn't going to meekly hand a pair over, and they end up in a one-on-one with the shoes as the prize!
Meanwhile, the first semifinal match is between Shutoku and Rakuzan, and the latter has not only acquired Akashi from the Generation of Miracles but also has three of the Five Uncrowned Kings on their starting lineup. The true powers of Rakuzan, which allowed them to create the strongest lineup in their history, is about to come into the open!

episodes.title: I Know None of That
episodes.synopsis: The first semifinal match is between Shutoku and Rakuzan. The offense and defense are both at high levels, creating a see-saw game, but the tides shift in the second quarter. Hayama, one of the "Five Uncrowned Kings," exhibits a dribble with tremendous power and overwhelms Miyaji, who was matched up against him. Furthermore, Otsubo loses a power battle before Nebuya. Everyone other than Midorima are burdens.. Such harsh words were thrown out. However, Midorima wasn't upset by the comment and throws a pass out to Miyaji!

episodes.title: I Will Offer Them
episodes.synopsis: Facing Akashi's Emperor Eye, which sees the future movements of the opponents, Shutoku looks like they had no hand to play. But the will to fight once again lights up within the eyes of the team members, and they face Rakuzan with the spirit of "unyielding tenacity"! Thanks to Midorima and Takao's trick play, they try to close the gap in one strong run, but to answer that, Akashi scores in his own goal to the shock of everyone around him. Against Shutoku, who bares their teeth without giving up until the very end, Akashi throws out words that show no mercy.

episodes.title: It Makes Me Laugh
episodes.synopsis: After the match Rakuzan vs.Shutoku, Rakuzan wins with the score of 86 - 70 against Shutoku. For the Shutoku team, it is a very huge defeat that even Takao and Midorima cried after the game. Kise, Kagami and Kuroko did have some short greetings before their match. The match started, how can Seirin stop Kise's Perfect Copy?

episodes.title: True Light
episodes.synopsis: The battle between Seirin and Kaijo finally begins. Seirin tries to secure their victory by striking first, but Kise  unexpectedly begins using his Perfect Copy at the start of the game, demonstrating his overwhelming strength.

episodes.title: Don`t Belittle Us!!
episodes.synopsis: The Seirin-Kaijo game was white-hot due to the battle between their ace players. With the defense and offense reversed now, Seirin goes on the offensive. As the last one to awaken, and one with potential comparable to the Generation of Miracles, Kagami was on his way to unleashing that latent talent. Kise felt that as a threat more than anyone else. That was why he definitely didn't want to lose!!

episodes.title: In Order to Win
episodes.synopsis: Kise's injury becomes worse. His coach orders him to step down the court for a while and rest until the last two minutes of the last quarter wherein he could use his Perfect Copy. Kagami's talents give way to Seirin having a 15-point gap in the lead with four minutes left in the game. Kise's frustration leads him to recover fast, determined to win the cup. Rico is surprised and realizes that Kise's Perfect Copy can now last until the end of the competition.

episodes.title: This Time, for Sure
episodes.synopsis: Kise recovers and manages to fill the 15-point gap. Kaijo becomes the lead with a score of 78-77. Seirin becomes restless and their moves become stiff as Kise's fast recovery and Kaijo's persistence to win makes the crowds cheer, putting Seirin under pressure. Kuroko devises a plan that requires time for observation in order to overcome Kise's Perfect Copy.

episodes.title: He Is the Best Player
episodes.synopsis: Kuroko finally finds a way to stop Kise, and Seirin wins with a deciding shot made by Kuroko. The episode ends with Kuroko telling a story about his past

episodes.title: A Day with Blue Skies
episodes.synopsis: Kuroko is first placed into Teiko's third string basketball team. However, after practicing everyday after school with Aomine, Akashi realised Kuroko talent as the "Phantom 6th Man." During a game between the third and second string, Kuroko proved himself and was upgraded to first string. But when he plays in a friendly game as starting player, he is so nervous he is subbed out immediately. The coaches are unsure if they should keep him on first string, but with Aomine's encouragement, they keep him on for one day. Now that Kuroko's nerves are under control, his help in the team is obvious and he is permanently placed on the first string bench.

episodes.title: ...Sorry
episodes.synopsis: Nijimura gives the captain position to Akashi because his father is sick. Akashi now becomes captain. The Teiko coach comes back. Midorima and Murasakibara gets into a fight, and Kuroko challenges them into a practice game. Then, Aomine and Kise get into a fight, but not a serious one. Akashi wants to get rid of Haizaki because he keeps skipping practices. Aomine plays a game, but he doesn't have fun and loses interest in basketball because he crushed the other team. Teiko goes to the National qualifiers, and Aomine meets his friend, while the face of Kuroko's friend is also revealed. Aomine ends up crushing his friend's team, and gets called a monster by his friend. Also, Kuroko's friend loses, and calls Kuroko, crying. The episode ends with Aomine sitting by the pool, a blank expression on his face.

episodes.title: We No Longer
episodes.synopsis: The old coach advises to Aomine to keep playing basketball until he can find a worthy opponent. Teiko wins the National finals. The old coach collapses and the young one takes over coaching the team. The team individually undergoes rapid growth in power. Aomine leaves mid-practice and the coach gives him permission to skip practices, leaving Aomine in even more despair. After an act of insubordination, Akashi goes head to head with Murasakibara, and just when Akashi is about to lose, he switches personalities and crushes Murasakibara. Akashi gives the rest of the team permission to skip practice as long as they win matches. He later tells Kuroko who failed to convince Aomine that there is two of him.

episodes.title: What Is Victory?
episodes.synopsis: Kuroko get's knocked unconscious in the game before the grand final, in which Teiko is set to play against Kuroko's friend, Shige's team. Kuroko regains consciousness, and since he cannot play in the game, asks Akashi to make Teiko play their best. Teiko, bored by scoring quotas, decide to play a new game. Kuroko gets to the match in time to see the conclusion of the game, with Murasakibara scoring the final goal for the opposite team in order to make the score read "111, 11". Devastated, Kuroko decides to quit basketball and visits Shige's school, where he finds out Shige has transferred and is going to quit basketball. Shige's friend tells him not to quit basketball, because he thinks Kuroko can melt their hearts.

episodes.title: Final Tip-Off!
episodes.synopsis: Seirin prepare mentally for the grand final match of the Winter Cup. Kagami and Tatsuya finally properly reconcile. The teams from previous matches, including the teams of the Generation of Miracles come to watch the grand final. During the decider for 3rd place, Kise sits out of the match and Shutoku wins against Kaijo, 96 to 54, taking 3rd place. Rakuzan and Seirin warm up, and Akashi declares the winner will be Rakuzan. Furihata gives Kuroko a wristband filled with the team's thoughts. The game starts with Kagami taking the tip off. Kuroko fumbles a pass but Kagami manages to score the first goal with an impossible jump. And enters "the zone".

episodes.title: Isn`t It the Best?
episodes.synopsis: Kagami dangerously continues using up his stamina in the zone, Riko swaps Kuroko for Mitobe so that Kagami can focus on offence. Akashi pairs up against Kagami and Akashi takes control of the game until Mitobe's defense breaks the flow. Kagami exits the zone, and Kuroko re-enters the game. Kuroko is more visible than usual, which Akashi claims is due to his learning how to dribble and shoot. Disheartened, Kuroko is taken out of the match for one side pass, then put back in for the remainder of the first quarter. The first quarter is finished with a tie, 21-21. Kuroko is set to sit out the 2nd quarter to think of a solution. Meanwhile Rakuzan's Chihiro Mayuzumi reveals his ability to misdirect just like Kuroko, but with better base attributes.

episodes.title: A Miracle Will Not Happen
episodes.synopsis: Kuroko observes Mayuzumi's play from the sidelines. Seirin subs in first-year Furihata to lure Rakuzan, but he quickly gets fatigued after facing Akashi. Fukuda, a first-year, takes his place. Hyuga goes up against Rakuzan's Reo Mibuchi (who Hyuga admired in middle school) in a "Battle of the shooting guards", but loses. The same happens to Kiyoshi against Eikichi Nebuya. Another first-year takes Fukuda's place. One-by-one, Rakuzan crushes Seirin's players. Akashi demonstrates that he can also make alley-oops, finishing the second quarter with Rakuzan in the lead, 62-37.

episodes.title: Weight of Resolve
episodes.synopsis: Rakuzan vs. Seirin enters the third quarter. Seirin, not giving up, entrusts their scorers Hyuga and Kagami with all their hope. However, even that small glimmer...

episodes.title: In My Own Way, I`m Desperate
episodes.synopsis: Kuroko is back in the game and he's able to stop Mayuzumi, but even with Kagami in the zone, Seirin has to defeat the Uncrowned Kings to win.

episodes.title: A Warning
episodes.synopsis: The game enters the final quarter. Hyuga is back on the court, having figured out how to beat Mibuchi; Kiyoshi faces Nebuya despite his knee pain.

episodes.title: Why Don`t We Give Up?
episodes.synopsis: With the clock ticking down, Akashi is in the zone and his strength is overwhelming. Kuroko suggests he and Kagami work together against him.

episodes.title: So It Was You
episodes.synopsis: Akashi is back to his old self and starts playing as a member of a team again, inspiring his teammates to play at their full potential against Seirin.

episodes.title: Many Times Over
episodes.synopsis: With 40 seconds remaining in the game, the Seirin team must unite and give it their all to have a hope of defeating Akashi and Rakuzan.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes On a New Position
episodes.synopsis: A few months into his appointment as the Liberion Order's special instructor, Beryl Gardenant is settling into his new life in the capital. One day, he's visited by Lucy and Ficelle, who ask him to become a temporary instructor at the Magic Institute. Beryl joins the sword magic course where Mewi is enrolled, witnesses Ficelle's teaching methods, and finds himself facing off against her...

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow
episodes.synopsis: Beryl wrestles with teaching Ficelle - who is a terrible teacher - how to actually teach. Mewi struggles to fit in with her fellow students, but a conversation with Cindy at lunch hints at that beginning to change. At a small party, Beryl views both Mewi and Ficelle's growth with satisfaction. And then an unexpected disturbance rocks the Magic Institute.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man
episodes.synopsis: Wolf-shaped shadows attack the teachers and magic is rendered useless on campus. Able to fight even without magic, Beryl and Ficelle force their way into the school in an effort to uncover the cause of the strange happenings. When shadow wolves appear in the cafeteria, Mewi and her classmates decide to confront them, despite their inexperience. Two battles unfold - so how will they end?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home
episodes.synopsis: A letter addressed to Beryl arrives from Beaden. Sent by his father Mordea, it urges him to return to the village for an annual event unique to the village. With the Magic Institute on summer break, Beryl invites Mewi to accompany him and Henblitz. Then Curuni invites herself along. It's the first time Beryl's been home since his move to the city. The next day, an unexpected confrontation occurs.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar
episodes.synopsis: Their mission to take down the saberboar begins. Curuni achieves her long-cherished goal of taking one down and realizes how much stronger she has become. Randrid makes full use of the skills he honed as an adventurer and puts his swordsmanship to good use. Impressed, Henblitz challenges him to a sparring match - which ignites something in the hearts of both Beryl and another swordsman.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father
episodes.synopsis: With the saberboar threat eliminated, Beaden holds its annual festival. The friendship between Henblitz and Randrid grows, while Adel and Edel fuss over Mewi. Beryl watches it all and reflects on his own feelings over the years. Then Mordea arrives and the two head for the dojo. Can Beryl overcome the giant wall that is his father?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility
episodes.synopsis: A banquet is being held in the lands of the Margrave of Flumvelk, a region bordering Sphenedyardvania, and both Allucia and Beryl have been invited. The visit is also a chance to confirm the route the soon-to-be-wed Princess Salacia will take to her new home. Along the way, Beryl gives advice to a young knight. When he arrives at his destination, an unexpected reunion awaits him.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Shueste, the sister of Beryl's former student Warren, relentlessly pursues Beryl - but for a good reason. Seeing this upsets Allucia, Warren explains both his and Shueste's motives, and encourages Allucia to make her own move. Beryl's actions at the banquet leave Shueste even more smitten. Having finished their assignment, Beryl and Allucia head home - but face an unforseen encounter on the way.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City
episodes.synopsis: Back in the capital, Beryl struggles to shake his guilt over Vesper's grave injuries, while Surena tries to cheer him up. The day of Princess Salacia's wedding draws near, and Beryl joins the escort detail. After a short reunion with Shueste and with the threat of an attack by the Verdapis Mercenary Company looming, they reach Dilmahakha, the holy city of Sphenedyardvania. But who is watching him?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year
episodes.synopsis: Allucia and Gatoga visit Beryl at his lodgings in Dilmahakha, and Gatoga shows Beryl around the city. Once they're alone, Gatoga tells him what became of Rose. Back in Baltrain, Curuni and Ficelle put Mewi through special training, while Lucy and Ibroy meet in secret. The new year arrives, bringing Princess Salacia's wedding - and screams of terror ring out through the cathedral.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage
episodes.synopsis: The Verdapis Mercenary Company bursts into the cathedral. Beryl moves to stop them, but Ibroy yells, "They're on our side!" Forced into an uneasy alliance, Beryl and the others escort the prince and princess safely to the palace. Along the way, Beryl's rage clashes with Hanoy's pride as a mercenary. But an even greater crisis engulfs the Holy City - caused by none other than Pope Morris himself.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home
episodes.synopsis: The masked White Maiden is revealed to be none other than Beryl's former student, Rose. Beryl and the White Maiden meet up with Allucia and Surena, who have successfully taken down the Chimera, and they head to back up the Verdapis Mercenary Company. There, they find Hanoy on the brink of defeat - and Pope Morris standing calmly before him. The final battle is about to begin.

info.title: #I'm Looking For a Zombie
info.synopsis: Tredici anni fa, il mondo è crollato nel caos durante il "Giorno Rosso": un'epidemia fulminante ha spazzato via il 90% dell’umanità, trasformando i morti in orde di zombie famelici. Le grandi città sono diventate territori proibiti, dominio dei non-morti, mentre i pochi sopravvissuti si sono rifugiati in villaggi isolati, sognando un giorno di poterle riconquistare. Oggi, una nuova generazione di ragazzi è cresciuta conoscendo soltanto questo mondo spezzato, senza memoria diretta di com'era la vita prima della catastrofe. Tra loro c'è Aki, una ragazza vivace e determinata, che vive insieme ai suoi migliori amici, Haru e Natsuki. Quando Aki scopre che suo padre, scomparso da anni, potrebbe essere ancora vivo, decide di intraprendere un viaggio per ritrovarlo.

episodes.title: I`m Looking For My Dad
episodes.synopsis: 13 years after the "Red Day," Aki leaves the village with Natsuki and Haru to search for her father.

episodes.title: Alla ricerca dell'ospedale
episodes.synopsis: Aki and Yu set out to find a hospital to treat Natsuki's wound.
